recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of seven men in 1960s-era fashion posed around a minimalist architectural plinth and an ornate stone fireplace surround. The composition is framed by a white border with heavy, blocky blue and mustard yellow typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the ornate classical fireplace and the clean brutalist lines of the building.
Rhythmic placement of figures across the horizontal plane at varying heights.
Color coordination between the subjects' clothing and the primary typographic accents.
coreInvariants: White outer border framing the central photograph.
Heavy horizontal blue bar separating the top text from the image.
Angled mustard-yellow pill-shaped badge in the upper left corner.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centrally located, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame, scaled to show full-body poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the green suit standing directly in front of the ornate fireplace.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the mustard badge top-left, moves across the bold blue title, then descends into the group portrait, following the staggered heights of the men.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top for metadata and branding; neutral grey/beige tones in the architectural background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary text and specific clothing items against a desaturated, neutral architectural background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, high-contrast sans-serif with minimal counters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'R' have almost closed counters due to weight.
Numbers are integrated into the same heavy weight as the letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary smaller sans-serif for metadata, and a slanted display face inside the yellow badge.
graphicDevices: Square logo container in top right

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy vertical presence and condensed nature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of seven men in 1960s soul-era fashion (suits, turtlenecks) posed around a white minimalist bench and a classical stone fireplace in front of a brutalist building. Leave a large white margin at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick horizontal blue line above the photo. Place ultra-bold, condensed blue uppercase text above the line. Add a mustard-yellow diagonal pill shape in the top left corner with dark text inside.

verificationChecks: Is the blue text extremely heavy with minimal white space inside the letters?
Is there a clear horizontal divider between the text and the image?
Does the group portrait feature 1960s-era styling and architecture?
Is the mustard yellow badge angled at approximately 20 degrees?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the group
Specific color of the primary display text
Architectural style of the background (e.g., more modern vs. more classical)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subjects.
Verify the white border is consistent on all four sides.
Check that the mustard yellow badge is clearly legible.
Confirm the blue bar is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject: Group Portrait] with [Setting: Architectural Contrast] framed by [Layout: White Border with Top-Heavy Typography] using [Font: Ultra-Bold Condensed Sans] in [Color: Royal Blue and Mustard Yellow].
